summary: Meditazioni multi-format media overhaul validated end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 tests pass covering (1) admin auth via /api/auth/login with email/password → Bearer token; (2) chunked upload lifecycle init/chunk/complete for PDF (media_type='pdf') and MP3 (media_type='audio'); (3) /api/media/{id} streaming — full 200 with correct Content-Type/size, Range 'bytes=0-99' → 206 with Content-Range and Content-Length=100 and Accept-Ranges: bytes, ?download=1 → Content-Disposition attachment; (4) provider detection for youtube, youtu.be, vimeo (76979871), spotify episode, tiktok, instagram, facebook → content_type='embed' + correct provider; (5) uploaded-media meditation → content_type == media_type, provider == 'upload'; (6) PATCH with new media_id deletes previous GridFS file (old GET /api/media/{id} → 404) and keeps new one; (7) DELETE meditation removes its GridFS media (GET /api/media/{id} → 404 after delete); (8) public GET /api/meditations excludes drafts and future-scheduled items while GET /api/meditations/{id} still returns them; categories endpoint OK; (9) auth guards return 401/403 on /api/admin/uploads/* and /api/admin/meditations POST/PATCH/DELETE without token; (10) backward compat — legacy meditation with only video_url returns decorated content_type/provider. Frontend (Public Ospite flow): Welcome → Continua come Ospite → Meditazioni tab lists items with category chips; tapping an item opens the in-app player rendering a YouTube iframe (https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ?rel=0&playsinline=1) plus 'Condividi' and 'Scarica' buttons — verified visually on mobile viewport (375x667). Admin UI intentionally not exercised (Google welcome gate + main agent already validated via curl).
action_items: Optional (defensive): /api/admin/uploads/{id}/chunk currently appends unlimited bytes to the temp file; consider enforcing the 1GB cap server-side per request/aggregate to guard against abuse (currently only the client enforces it).

Optional: _ffmpeg_grab_frame stores the poster as an inline base64 data URL on the meditation doc. For very small clips this is fine; for large libraries consider persisting the frame as a GridFS file and returning /api/media/{id} to keep documents lean and cache-friendly.
Optional: on PATCH replace, the response returns {ok: true} only — consider returning the decorated document so the admin UI can refresh without a second fetch.

Optional (perf): /api/media/{id} calls fs_bucket.open_download_stream per Range request; consider ETag/Last-Modified headers to enable client caching across ranged fetches (currently only Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _decorate_meditation is non-destructive and correctly prioritizes media_id/media_type over video_url — backward compatibility for legacy docs (video_url only) is preserved.
server.py chunked upload writes chunks with binary-append (open(part, 'ab')) — correct for arbitrary Range/order-in chunk sequences from the client's perspective (client sends serially).
server.py /api/media/{id} correctly implements RFC 7233 Range support: Content-Range, Content-Length, 206 status, Accept-Ranges: bytes, and ?download toggles Content-Disposition inline↔attachment.

server.py PATCH admin_edit_meditation deletes previous GridFS file only when 'media_id' key is present in updates AND differs from the previous — protects against accidental deletion when the client only edits metadata.
server.py DELETE admin_delete_meditation cascades GridFS cleanup for both the main media_id and every attachment id — no orphan files.
server.py _gridfs_delete swallows exceptions silently (best-effort); acceptable but consider logging failures to catch corrupt refs early.
server.py all meditation responses use find(..., {'_id': 0}) — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage.
server.py detect_provider returns None for unknown URLs; _decorate_meditation then falls back to content_type='video' when video_url is set but provider is unknown — reasonable default.
Frontend embeds.ts + MeditationPlayer.web.tsx render the correct YouTube embed URL (rel=0, playsinline=1) — verified via the iframe src on the detail screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public Ospite → Meditazioni → item detail with iframe player + Condividi + Scarica verified on 375x667 viewport)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates only TEST_-prefixed meditations and uploads TEST_-prefixed files to GridFS. A module-scoped fixture deletes every created meditation (which cascades GridFS cleanup). One additional TEST_UI_Meditazione (med_482f8337e481) was seeded for browser testing and manually deleted afterwards. A final DB sweep confirmed 0 meditations and 0 GridFS media files remaining — the collection is left clean as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_meditations_media.py. It authenticates via POST /api/auth/login using pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / AdminTestPwd1! (allowlist admin — any password grants admin, but this exact one is set in test_credentials.md). It generates a minimal valid PDF + a synthetic MP3 (id3+frame) inline — no external files required. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_meditations_media.py -v. GridFS bucket name is 'media'. If parallel xdist is enabled (default in pytest.ini), tests are still safe because each test scopes its own media/meditation IDs. Admin UI cannot be tested via browser (Google welcome gate); use curl or the pytest suite for admin flows.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 22 tests passed on first execution after fixing a test-only issue: EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not exported to the pytest env (only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is in frontend/.env). Added a hard fallback to the public preview URL in the test file to mirror existing tests. Product code unchanged.
